data_source: REAL: NCRB district-wise IPC crimes 2001-2012 (data.gov.in) + Census 2011 (Registrar General of India) + Karnataka DES district income 2021-22

known_proxies.unemployment_rate: Census 2011 non-workforce-participation proxy, not official unemployment survey data
known_proxies.poverty_rate: Census 2011 household-amenity deprivation proxy (LPG access), not an official poverty line measure
known_proxies.police_per_capita: no open district-level dataset found; fixed state-average estimate
known_proxies.school_density: no open district-level dataset found; fixed state-average estimate
known_proxies.hospital_density: no open district-level dataset found; fixed state-average estimate
known_proxies.month_sin/cos/festival_flag: NCRB source data is annual only, no real monthly signal available
